title: Privacy and secure configuration
problem: Sensitive data and overprivileged configuration can escape review.
rationale: Product data/auth/config changes require review. No collection of real customer data for coverage or fixtures.
applicability: Changed data handling, authentication or security configuration.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: mapped retention/redaction/config tests and dependency/secret checks.
target_check.reviewer: data purpose/minimisation, retention, least privilege and threat assumptions.
target_check.limits: **D:** mapped retention/redaction/config tests and dependency/secret checks. **R:** data purpose/minimisation, retention, least privilege and threat assumptions.

expected_evidence: **D:** mapped retention/redaction/config tests and dependency/secret checks. **R:** data purpose/minimisation, retention, least privilege and threat assumptions.
